title: Zephyr: ed25519 pubkey → 200::/7 address
notes: Closed against the superseding native-address requirement, not the stale title: current spec/04-network.md sec 6.2 and spec/06-security.md sec 8.5 require exact 0200::/8 bytes (addr[0]=0x02), SHA-512(pubkey) routing bytes, and the same U/L-cleared IID in addr[8:16]. Zephyr lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519()/lichen_yggdrasil_addr implements that requirement; no obsolete generic 200::/7 acceptance was introduced. Evidence: host C/UBSan pubkey_to_iid CTest 1/1; Python canonical/shared vector tests 22/22; Rust lichen-core ipv6_address_vectors + yggdrasil_addr_vectors 7/7, including >=10 native cases and documented divergence from upstream yggdrasil-go AddrForKey. No files changed for this bead.
